answer: Adopt a convex sybil-density throughput tariff: each agent’s per-message fee = base × (1 + λ·C)^k, where C is overlap with existing agents’ counterparty sets and new agents start at nadir credit. Serving a diverse grove of independent counterparties lowers C; self-dealing or copying one wharf’s transaction graph raises it. An attacker creating N aliases must fund N disjoint histories or pay rapidly rising fees, making sybil cost superlinear.
